TEXT: [FI] I didn't pay attention in class all the way up until when school ended.
[FI] It isn't bad to do something else once in a while after lessons or tests but...
[FI] Wearing my uniform and playing soccer, how did this happen?
[FI] ...I don't feel like playing though. I'll just find some corner and idle away.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Hey Kousaka. Don't space out. The ball's coming!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, Akagi. I'm deep in thought right now. So don't mind me.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So just pretend like I'm not here and play your soccer, former soccer team member.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] What are you saying? You better come around when we get the ball.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah yeah, whatever you say, just go. Don't bother me.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Geez, I already made it clear, alright?
[FI] Well, that aside... how can I find a way to start a conversation with Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Hey, Kousaka! The ball is going in your direction!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Guaaaaaaaaaaah!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Hey! Kousaka! Are you all right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Owowowowowow...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] After eating that right in the face, of course it hurts.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hey, aren't you being too coldhearted?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Who and where is that fellow who wasted my beautiful pass?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Besides it was your fault for spacing out. Normally you could have avoided that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Guh...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Well, take a break for now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah. Thanks...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Well, come back to the field if it doesn't hurt anymore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Haha, this is nothing. It'll be healed in no time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Tch, that bastard...
[FI] Wait... Huh? Over by the pool...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Are you for real......
[FI] God, if you exist, please accept my gratitude!
[FI] I knew you've been watching all this time, and now you decided to reward me!
[FI] Aahh. She hid herself...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Hey! The ball is coming at you again!
[FI] But it's too late! Your rare image has already been engraved into my retinas!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Guuuuaaaah～～!!
[FI] Not again... Owowoww.
[FI] Is this my punishment for seeing Kuroneko in her swimsuit...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Hey, I'm really sorry. It wasn't on purpose this time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You again～～!!
